test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: Sunita is ranked 10th from the top and 18th from the bottom in her class. How many students are there in the class?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Sunita is ranked 10th from the top.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbae5faafcb5788335f611acad3c037f56bf2c63fca581b843fcb6e814f6b03e.png] 

2) Sunita is 18th from the bottom in her class.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da7e948273305190e3c107723169ec2ba6edfbd0bd105e85530b9167ccf2e3d2.png] 

On combining, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fd66750e9c4cff20f396874a39a6ba9e8a8e443d2265ec5cb26c149e7a97995.png] 

Number of students in the class = (9 + 1 + 17) = 27

Hence, the correct answer is **"27"**.
